### Thank you for suggesting an improvement!

Please ensure the following:

- Base the request on the latest commit or prerelease.
- Describe one concrete use case and the current limitation.
- State the expected behavior.
- Keep the request concise, focused and as short as possible.
- Describe the problem before suggesting implementation details.
- Do not submit repository-wide solutions or refactoring proposals without discussing the direction with the maintainers first. 
  The maintainers will determine the appropriate design and any necessary follow-up work.

- Write the request in your own words.
- Do not paste AI-generated issue reports, analyses or solutions.
- If AI was used as a supporting tool, independently verify every claim and be prepared to explain the request without relying on generated text.
- Submitting a request means staying engaged while it is evaluated.
Be prepared for detailed technical follow-up with the maintainers.
- Complex requests may benefit from a mutually arranged voice call, while the issue remains the written record.
